assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting.
This service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis codes I47.1 and I25.10.
